label: No two distinct things depend for their being on each other; if x is distinct from y and x depends…
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise: no two distinct things depend for their being on each other; if x is distinct from y and x depends for its being on y, then y does not depend for its being on x. Restricted to distinct things because DependsForBeing, read counterfactually, holds trivially of a thing and itself. Navigation only (no claim): Aquinas, In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 18, 'priora non dependent a posterioribus, sicut e converso'.
